body_excerpt:
A security update has been released for a third-party operating system kernel to address multiple defects. The Ubuntu vulnerabilities affect the network file sharing server and client, IPv4 and IPv6 packet processing including in-band telemetry, packet filtering, several socket and transport layers, the network file system server, virtualization support, and multiple storage, cryptographic, and Ethernet device drivers. The defect classes are use-after-free, out-of-bounds read and write, integer overflow and underflow, and race conditions between concurrent request paths. An attacker with network or local access could potentially cause a denial of service, disclose adjacent memory, or corrupt memory in a manner that could lead to arbitrary code execution in a privileged context. The vendor has evaluated these issues against affected offerings and resolved them in the referenced maintenance release.

The following CVEs have been addressed:
CVE-2026-23272, CVE-2026-23278, CVE-2026-23428, CVE-2026-23450, CVE-2026-23455, CVE-2026-31402, CVE-2026-31478, CVE-2026-31607, CVE-2026-31635, CVE-2026-31637, CVE-2026-31649, CVE-2026-31657, CVE-2026-31659, CVE-2026-31668, CVE-2026-31669, CVE-2026-31682, CVE-2026-31685, CVE-2026-43011, CVE-2026-43037, CVE-2026-43038, CVE-2026-43071, CVE-2026-43114, CVE-2026-43117, CVE-2026-43186, CVE-2026-43304, CVE-2026-43341, CVE-2026-43383, CVE-2026-43406, CVE-2026-43407, CVE-2026-43414, CVE-2026-43493, CVE-2026-43501, CVE-2026-45988, CVE-2026-46043, CVE-2026-46119, CVE-2026-46135, CVE-2026-46195, CVE-2026-46243, and CVE-2026-46316.

Products not listed in the Impact Details section have not been evaluated.  Furthermore, products that have exceeded any software maintenance time periods are also not evaluated and will not be published.  Please consult End of Sale and End of Service Life - Extreme Networks for the EOL notices related to the product under question.
